en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a neoclassical mansion set within a lush garden. The building has a flat roof, symmetrical façade, balcony with balustrade, and a central portico with columns. Trees and dense foliage frame a curved driveway leading to the entrance. Decorative printed text and a round stamp-like mark appear on the left in red ink, and additional red text appears at lower right. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overprinted across the bottom.
